methods.label: Require two distinct intersections
methods.explanation: The radius must be greater than half the length of $AB$ for the two arcs to intersect at two points, thereby determining a line.

review.mathematicalCheck: For the common compass radius r, two distinct intersections require $2r>AB$. At equality there is only the midpoint intersection; below it there are none.
